notes: 2026-10-16 Dom: Arena 1 play circle +30% (it was too small): ARENA_ONE_SCALE 0.36 -> 0.468 (play-radius-defs row, 0.36 x 1.3).
2026-10-13 Dom: stances 2x bigger, they were too small to feel. Trickster feint held at -75% (2x would be -100% = free feints).
2026-10-13 Dom: no time change in a live zone: every hit-stop pause set to 0 (ms, frames); flash + ground ring added per contact (sandbox-mech impact).

2026-10-14 Dom: reach bands (positioning gates): a landed blow outside its weapon's best distance band deals 40% (bandOff 400); inner <1.35 m, mid 1.35-1.8 m, outer beyond; NO on-screen marker (Dom: cheap). Strategy: never soften a hard miss.

2026-10-14 Dom: armour vs blow type: plate takes 60% of cuts, 90% of stabs, 140% of crushes; leathers 85/65/100; robes 130/130/120 (blowKinds + armourVs rows); maul and warhammer crush, estoc and every thrust pierce, the rest cut.
2026-10-14 Dom: commit vs bait: maul and warhammer heavies are 30% longer in the windup, cannot be feinted and shrug every stagger from the first tick; the dodge counter punishes them.
2026-10-14 Dom: ward: the Witch's raised guard throws the first blow back (80% of it at the attacker, never to death) and is down for 4 s; a cheap light pops it first.

2026-10-14 Dom: shield wall vs flank: a side blow on a raised guard (outside its arc, not from behind) deals 120% and 140% posture; the Shieldmaiden cannot step while her guard is up, so the answer is the shove or the flank.
2026-10-14 Dom: clock fighter: a landed Plague Doctor special poisons you: 2 health a second for 10 s, refreshed by a new landing, never to death; no marker, the health bar is the signal.

2026-10-14 Dom: bind and disarm: a block with a trident or estoc binds the attacker's blade for 0.75 s (no swings, kick is legal); kick to break it or be disarmed for 5 s (kick and guard only). Disarmed has no fists animation yet: the weapon stays in hand, it simply cannot swing.

2026-10-15 Dom + Strategy: mana: a third bar of 100, spells cost mana (1.5x the spell's stamina cost) and no stamina, regen 6 a second after 1.5 s without casting, slowed by heavy armour (the casting penalty rows); stamina stays the melee cost.

2026-10-15 Dom + Strategy: missiles: the weapon picked as the STAFF in the Loadout box (?staff=<weapon>, default none) throws a bolt instead of striking (stab forward, left slash left bolt, right slash right bolt, heavy forward at 150%), 12 mana, 7 m/s, side bolts fan 22 degrees; it only flies from the outer band (a hard miss up close); dodge, a same-side guard or a sidestep answers it.

2026-10-15 Dom + Strategy: bow and crossbow (stand-in weapons picked in the Loadout box: ?bow= / ?crossbow=): a bow draws 20% slower and is fast and light, a crossbow reloads 120% slower, hits for 170% and a third of a blocked bolt goes through; both carry a finite quiver (20 arrows / 12 bolts; ?quiver=0 for unlimited), the staff is infinite and costs mana.

2026-10-13 Dom: arm wound: the first blade wound to the torso scars the sword arm for the fight: blocks cost 30% more stamina, damage dealt 20% less (sandbox-mech wounds; the sim has no arm site, torso stands in).

2026-10-14 Dom + Strategy: the arm wound row is OFF (a wound that forms only at 10% health is a penalty on the loser, no decision, a PvP snowball). Idea kept in docs/state/combat-new-ideas-2026-10-13.md with the test for any return.
2026-10-13 Dom: crowd roars on big moments: a loud reaction on parry, guard break and heavy hits with no cooldown, and a roar on the kill (sandbox-mech crowd).
2026-10-13 Dom: flash removed, ring now thin grey and only on parry and guard break; crowd roars about 4x louder.
2026-10-13 Dom: arm wound shows as a temporary on-screen message (option B), about 2.6 seconds.

2026-10-13 Strategy/Dom: ring stays ON as a row (parry, guard break); the existing clash sparks are wired to guard break as the switchable alternative (guardBreak sparks 0.8; parry already sparks on steel). Flip either in the panel.
2026-10-13 Dom: ring off (looked basic); the clash sparks on guard break stay. Sandbox working mode: Dom's word beats the process rules; nothing leaves sandbox/page or the preview.

2026-10-13 Dom: many-on-one damage cut: 1st attacker 100%, 2nd 50%, 3rd 30%, 4th and later 30%, per fight kind (same in every kind today). Values only: the engine applies them in Combat's many-on-one resolution (harness scripts/many-on-one-check.mjs); the sandbox is 1v1 so it cannot show the effect.
2026-10-13 Dom: counter after a dodge: a clean roll-dodge opens the guard-counter window for 20 ticks (Heavy becomes the counter), same as a block does.
2026-10-13 Dom: arm wound also takes 10 off the stamina ceiling for the rest of the fight (wounds with a concrete cost).

2026-10-13 Dom: three armour classes. Light = leathers (stamina up, armour down), medium = mail (armour +12, stamina +3, magic resist -15), heavy = plate (armour +25, magic resist -15, stamina -10: the weight cost). One blended value per set, no hit locations.
2026-10-13 Dom: heavy armour slows casting: a special's windup is +20% in plate, +10% in leathers, 0 in robes (sandbox-mech castPenalty, read off the sheet dials; same numbers as #2577).
2026-10-13 Dom: the arm wound only forms once the defender is at 10% health or lower (wound row column below).
2026-10-13 Dom: execution via posture break: the critical heavy that lands after a posture break hits 1.5x, and finishes a foe at or under 25% health (sandbox-mech execution).

2026-10-14 Dom: no posture effects: the base animation only, no tired hunch, no open-stagger arm lift, no charge lean, no stance silhouette (sandbox-mech plainPosture). Guard-side tilt and finishers stay.

2026-10-13 Lead: armour weights now match #2577 (src/fight/armour-weights.json, castPenalty heavy 20 / medium 10 / light 0): heavy = plate, medium = leathers, light = robes, no mail set. The line above is superseded. The cast hook is Combat's, built on #2577.
2026-10-16 Dom: enrage removed (the boss-phase row is gone; phases is empty again, so no boss changes at 50% health).

2026-10-13 Dom: boss phase: at 50% health a boss's special hits 1.5x as hard and is ready after 30% of its cooldown (attack change, no colour change), with an on-screen message. A cast cut early now locks the caster out up to twice as long.
